name: Asuka
source:
A lonely 20-year-old girl who has no relatives. She was a normal college student at first, but when she started attending a host club, she became tainted by the night district.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2022/07/08/kagotori/]Official Site[/url]]
